hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: [antigravity plugin] LEAN ROUTING: Two routing modes are supported: 'Always use Agy (strict)' and 'Use Agy when appropriate (soft)'. The first session for a workspace asks once for the mode; until answered, substantive native work is held to the strict gate. Explicit choices persist per workspace across new sessions, reconnect/resume, compact, reboot, and app restart; ask again only when no valid choice exists. Strict delegates broad or substantive work (discovery, edits, review, verification, Git, research, media, subagents, terminal) to agy/Gemini, while tiny orchestration helpers, up to three bounded operations on one small file, and host-only capabilities remain native. A safe compound command that only prepares an Agy prompt with cd/cat/Get-Content and then invokes an Agy worker is allowed; unrelated or destructive shell chains remain denied. In soft mode, reminders are advisory. Default to `--tier flash` (latest Flash High); `--tier flash-medium` is an explicit option for clearly simple work. Reserve Pro for exceptional escalation. Prefer direct wrappers over a native Claude subagent. For repository exploration use `agy-scout`; for diff verification use `agy-review`, and ingest compact digests rather than raw files/diffs. For Claude and Codex at every effort level, aim for 200-500 instruction words and always stay below 800. At 800 words summarize before proceeding; count all chunks together. Task files and stdin cannot bypass this cap. Reference paths; only automatically supplied review diffs have a separate data limit. Give real workers at least a 30-minute hard timeout, using 45-60 minutes for broad multi-file or build-heavy work; reserve short limits for probes. Run the smallest sufficient test/build/lint gate. One builder, one blind verifier, and at most one repair; no agent loops. Preserve user changes and require authorization for commit/push or external/destructive actions. `AGY_ALWAYS_YOLO=1` or `always_yolo=on` grants broad machine access. If a Gemini run fails, inspect both 5h and 7d quotas; either at or below 2% is depleted. Never switch models automatically: ask the user whether to kill stalled Agy workers and continue with Claude Sonnet 4.6, or keep them alive and check both windows every 10 minutes. A user-approved Sonnet fallback must do the task itself without nested agents; the wrapper requires a direct-completion status and evidence receipt instead of trusting exit 0 alone. Append newly emitted English 75%/50%/25%/10% quota advisories. Full details are in the `antigravity` skill.
